अभोक्तृ,
°भोगिन् a. Not using or enjoying, abstemious.

[आ-भुज्-घञ्] 
__1 Curving, winding. 
__2 A curve; आभोगकुटिला (गङ्गा) [[Mb.]]; crumpling. 
__3 Circuit, circumference, expanse, extension, precincts, environs; अकथितोऽपि ज्ञायत एव यथायमाभोगस्तपावेनस्येति [[Ś. 1]]; गगनाभोगः the expanse of heaven, wide firmament of the sky; [[
.]] प्रासादाभोगः the middle part of a palace; प्रासादाभोगविस्तीर्णः स्तुतिशब्दो ह्यवर्तत [[

.]] 
__4 Magnitude, fulness, extent, expansive form; गण्डाभोगात् [[

]], 333. 
__5 Effort. 
__6 The expanded hood of a cobra (used by Varuṇa as his umbrella). 
__7 Enjoyment, satiety, completion; विषयाभोगेषु नैवादरः [[Śāntilakṣaṇa.]] 
__8 Serpent. आभोगं हन्मना हतम् [[
a. Ved. Not sacrificing; not giving food to the gods.
Not eating, fasting, abstinence; त्रिरात्रं स्यादभोजनम् [[
a. Not to be eaten, prohibited as food, impure, unholy; °अन्न a. one whose food is prohibited from being eaten by others; य एतेऽन्ये त्वभोज्यान्नाः कमशः परिकीर्तिताः [[
a. [आभोगं याति या-क] To be enjoyed (as Soma juice); [[

Ved. 
__1 Enjoyment. 
__2 Living, supporting life. 
__3 Food, nourishment; [[
